info.name: Class Flow Mobile API v1
info.description:
Import this collection + one Local environment. Run **Auth → Login** first (saves Bearer token + ids). Then Run folder.

Empty path ids are skipped (Runner otherwise sends `/teachers/batches` and `/batches/status` → 404). Re-import this file after every collection change.

**Branch Manager:** `Class-Flow-Mobile-API.postman_environment.json`.

**Phase 2 Teacher (option B):** `Class-Flow-Mobile-API.teacher.postman_environment.json` (`teacher@demo-institute.test`). Default teacher only has dashboard + own batches — 403 on exams/homework/attendance and Teachers directory is expected.

**Phase 3 Parent:** `Class-Flow-Mobile-API.parent.postman_environment.json`. Login fills `student_id` from `user.children[0]`.

**Phase 4 Receptionist:** `Class-Flow-Mobile-API.receptionist.postman_environment.json`.

**Phase 5 Accountant:** `Class-Flow-Mobile-API.accountant.postman_environment.json`.

**Phase 6 Principal:** `Class-Flow-Mobile-API.principal.postman_environment.json` (`principal@demo-institute.test`).

Disable Change password + Logout in Runner. Batch toggle/update only run after **Batch create** succeeds.
